regime_notes: No ecosystem crossed a fresh prospective paper-trade threshold. Solana remains highly active at about $2.35B DEX volume/24h versus $17.85B/7d, but the latest daily run rate is below the trailing-week average, stablecoin supply is about -0.94% over seven days, and 24h net inflows are only about +$9M. This is ongoing velocity rather than a new retained-capital migration signal.

BSC, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche and Sui all fail the fresh-acceleration test on current spot DEX throughput. Sui stablecoins remain a constructive outlier at roughly +8.8% over seven days, but its current DEX volume (~$12M/24h versus ~$283M/7d) and negligible net inflows do not confirm discretionary speculative migration. Existing SUI is therefore HOLD with no add.

Monad is the standout raw anomaly: perp volume is about $372M/24h versus $926M/7d, roughly 2.8x the preceding-six-day daily pace, with Perpl responsible for most of the surge (~$296M/24h). The framework rejects this as a qualified signal because Perpl is actively running its Purple Summer mPoints/reward campaign with weekly trading rewards/referrals and a large MON reward pool. Volume is therefore incentive-contaminated. MON also carries substantial low-float/FDV dilution risk.

Robinhood Chain retains strong stablecoin growth (~+8.2% over seven days) and large nominal DEX turnover (~$1.35B/24h), but current DEX pace is below its trailing-week average, net inflows are negative (~-$14M/24h), and prior synthetic-volume/maker contamination remains unresolved. No asset is promoted from this surface.

Uniswap has materially cooled from the condition that justified the UNI starter: aggregate DEX volume is now about $2.0B/24h, with roughly $1.24B coming from Robinhood Chain, versus roughly $4.59B/24h at the qualifying alert. UNI is about $6.33 versus the $6.45 paper mark. However, no hard structural failure, verified whale-distribution reversal, or invalidation of the protocol-fee-to-UNI-burn mechanism surfaced. The position remains HOLD_NO_ADD rather than being trimmed.

Hyperliquid perp volume has cooled sharply to about $1.96B/24h versus $39.59B/7d, while open interest remains high near $14.24B and fee/holder revenue remains substantial (~$733K fees and ~$584K holder revenue over 24h) with zero protocol incentives reported. HYPE is about $78.67 versus the $79.35 paper mark. No sufficiently fresh independent-wallet convergence or structural break was verified, so HYPE remains HOLD_NO_ADD; dilution/unlock risk remains a major caveat.

RWA asset stocks are large but do not create a new direct-token trade. Current active RWA market-cap figures are roughly Ethereum $14.5B, BSC $4.88B, Solana $2.45B, Avalanche $0.90B, Arbitrum $0.85B, Monad $0.40B, Robinhood Chain $0.27B and Base $0.18B. The deterioration versus the prior mark is mostly market movement in the two new speculative positions plus ordinary opening-inventory beta; neither UNI nor HYPE has crossed a thesis-risk threshold that justifies a trim or exit. No paper trade is justified, and state.json plus the immutable trade ledger remain unchanged.
